WITH film_rate_per_day AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    rental_rate / rental_duration AS rate_per_day
  FROM film
),
rating_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rate_per_day) AS per_rating_avg,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film_rate_per_day
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(per_rating_avg) AS overall_avg
  FROM rating_averages
  WHERE per_rating_avg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ra.rating,
  ra.per_rating_avg,
  ra.film_count,
  ra.per_rating_avg / oa.overall_avg AS normalized_ratio
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE ra.per_rating_avg IS NOT NULL AND oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CASE ra.rating
    WHEN 'G' THEN 1
    WHEN 'PG' THEN 2
    WHEN 'PG-13' THEN 3
    WHEN 'R' THEN 4
    WHEN 'NC-17' THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END
